lines.zh: 沉重的脚步声回荡在石块间。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps echo among the stones.

lines.zh: 石块之间有轻声的摩擦。
lines.en: Slight grating sounds between stone pieces.
Its steps are heavy and resolute.

lines.zh: 在石块上留下深深的印迹。
lines.en: Leaves deep impressions on the stones.

lines.zh: 石块间摩擦发出的声响。
它的脚步声稳定而沉重。
lines.en: Its footsteps are steady and heavy.

lines.zh: 碎石从关节缝里掉下来。
lines.en: Gravel sifts out of my joints.

lines.zh: 每走一步，地面都颤一下。
lines.en: The ground shudders with each step.

lines.zh: 我踏过的地方留下石坑。
lines.en: Stone pits are left where I tread.
My heavy legs drag me onward.

lines.zh: 我站成一堆石头，等人路过。
lines.en: I stand as a heap of stones, waiting for someone to pass.

lines.zh: 苔藓爬上了我的肩，我不动。
lines.en: Moss creeps onto my shoulder; I stay still.

lines.zh: 石头做的我不需要呼吸。
lines.en: Being made of stone, I don't need to breathe.

lines.zh: 它静静地守护着这片土地。

lines.en: A layer of dust has settled on my rock skin.

lines.zh: 身体里的石块互相抵着。
lines.en: The stones inside me brace against each other.

lines.zh: 我这一身石头，站了很久了。
lines.en: I've stood still in this stone body a long while.

lines.zh: 我的石拳握起来就掉渣。
lines.en: My stone fist crumbles when it clenches.

lines.zh: 你站在我影子里，我低头看你。
lines.en: You stand in my shadow; I lower my head to look.

lines.zh: 它的眼神中充满了警惕。
lines.en: Its eyes are full of alertness.

lines.zh: 我认得你身上的镐子味。
lines.en: I know the smell of a pickaxe on you.
You are not the one who woke me.

lines.zh: 再走一步，我的拳头就落下来。
lines.en: One more step and my fist comes down.
You have stepped onto my ground.
You want to smash me with stones?
Trying to tempt me with food? Ha!
What can you do to me?

lines.zh: 岩石是我的家，我在这里！
lines.en: I am made of rocks, I belong here!

lines.zh: 我是被驯服的石头，别试。
lines.en: I'm tamed stone — don't test me.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸口，像撞上山壁。
lines.en: You hit my chest as if hitting a cliff.
Hard as I am, it means nothing.
I am as steady as a mountain!

lines.zh: 你一拳打来，只磕掉我一块碎石。
lines.en: Your punch only knocks a chip off my rubble.

lines.zh: 哪里有石头在动，我就往哪走。
lines.en: Wherever stone stirs, that's where I go.

lines.zh: 石头也想挨着另一块石头。
lines.en: Even stone wants to rest against other stone.

lines.zh: 石头人也想找块石头做伴。
lines.en: Even a stone golem wants a stone companion.

lines.zh: 山那边有石块碰撞的回声。
lines.en: Across the hills there's the echo of stone on stone.

lines.zh: 我迈开石腿，朝你压过去。
lines.en: I spread my stone legs and bear down on you.

lines.zh: 石缝里的眼睛对准了你。
lines.en: The eyes in my stone seams fix on you.
The target has entered the stone heap.
My master called, so I move.

lines.zh: 岩石拳头已经抬起来了。
我的拳头在抬起来，很慢。

lines.en: Once my stone fist moves, you are done.

lines.zh: 石臂抬起，瞄准你的胸口。
lines.en: Stone arm rises, aimed at your chest.
You will not dodge this blow.
I bear down like a small mountain.
Your armor will not stop stone.

lines.zh: 发出震耳欲聋的轰鸣声！

lines.en: A huge stone slab smashes the ground!

lines.zh: 石块从天而降，砸向敌人！
lines.en: A stone slab falls from the sky and smashes the enemy!
A big stone thuds with tremors!

lines.zh: 轰隆隆的声音来自巨石！
lines.en: A rumbling sound comes from the stone!
A stone slab smashes the enemy’s head!

lines.zh: 我一拳砸地，石屑溅到你脸上。
lines.en: I punch the ground and grit sprays your face.
This blow cracks the very ground!
Hard against hard, and you lose.

lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，石头傀儡苏醒！
巨石缓慢地从地底升起！
lines.en: A huge stone rises slowly from the ground!
Stone blocks gather, the stone golem appears!
A huge stone rises from the stone pile!

lines.zh: 岩石在石堆上堆积成形！
lines.en: Rocks pile up into the stone golem!

lines.zh: 从石堆中缓缓走出石傀儡！
lines.en: A stone golem slowly walks out from the stone pile!

lines.zh: 石块堆积成巨大的石傀儡！
lines.en: Stone blocks stack into a huge stone golem!
The stone golem rises from the stone pile!

lines.zh: 岩石在石堆上慢慢堆积！
lines.en: Rocks slowly pile up on the stone golem!

lines.zh: 石堆上缓缓升起石傀儡！
lines.en: A stone golem slowly rises from the stone pile!
Stone stacks itself piece by piece.
The spawn egg lands and I take shape.

lines.zh: 我被摆在地上，然后站起。
lines.en: I was set down, then I stood.
A hundred points of stone, awake.
Blasted gravel rains down around me.
Even stone can be worn hollow by hunger.
